definition: RAMnets is one of the oldest practical neurally inspired classification algorithms.
details: The RAMnets is also known as a type of "n-tuple recognition method" or "weightless neural network".
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. And that shape of the machine — RAMnets — is what makes everything else possible.
